items.description: Report does not quantify the claim amount or the fakeToken X amount, so the exact underflow magnitude is not bound; only the zero real-quote pending balance and the revert outcome are stated.
Exact amount X of fakeToken and whether the fakeToken transferFrom succeeds are not quantified; the DoS is asserted qualitatively.
Report asserts DoS is permanent until migration/upgrade but gives no recovery mechanism details; permanence cannot be encoded as a bounded temporal relation.
